instructions:
## Raben: how a mockup is written - Use the class names of the module (Atlas + Raben): `card`, `btn btn-primary`, `form-group`, `form-control`, `table`, `badge badge-*`, `nav-tabs`, `alert alert-*`, `rb-header` with `rb-logo`, `rb-kpi`, `raben-layout` with `raben-sidebar`, `raben-topbar`, `raben-content`. - The look: Barlow, brand red #E30311, grey #F7F7F7 page, white cards, 1px #E6E6E6 lines, 4–8px corners. - Kit 1.0.0, made from the RabenDesign module as the demo app RabenDesignSystem at commit c8db48a (2026-10-28). When the module changes, the kit is updated in the raben-app skill (reference/design-kit.json) and imported into the Team server again. ## v2: the real Raben Design System - The kit now holds the whole Raben Design System stylesheet: write mockups with the RDS markup — Data grid 2 (`widget-datagrid`, `widget-datagrid-header header-filters`, `widget-datagrid-grid` with `tr`/`th`/`td`, `rb-col-id`, `rb-col-num`, `rb-col-alert`, `pagination-bar`), `pageheader`, `card`, `rb-kv rb-kv-lines`, `rb-kpi`, `rb-tag rb-tag-positive|negative|attentive|info|grey`, `alert alert-info|warning|success|secondary`, `wizard wizard-arrow`, `mx-tabcontainer-tabs`, `modal-dialog`. - Icons: `` (SVG is removed from mockups). - A page mockup is the content of the page (`
